title: The Olde Pink House
axis: Local +X points toward Abercorn Street and Reynolds Square. Local +Z follows the original street elevation away from East Bryan Street.

nativeAxes.x: from rear toward the front portico
nativeAxes.z: along the frontage away from East Bryan Street

features.role: Named footprint of the Olde Pink House at the address shown in the city preservation inventory.

identityStatus: Surveyed map outline, named historic inventory and two exact publicly released Historic American Buildings Survey photographs.

terrainContact.basis: Original sidewalk elevation between the porch and Abercorn Street.

notes: The stuccoed brick house has two storeys over a basement, end parapets and chimneys, slate gable, corner quoins, regular six-over-six windows with metal hoods and a Palladian window over the balustraded Doric entrance porch.
